UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT FOR THE EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA ALEXANDRIA DIVISION

MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE,

Plaintiff,  v.  KATIE HALL, individually; NATIONAL CENTER FOR MISSING & EXPLOITED CHILDREN; META PLATFORMS, INC.; and JOHN/JANE DOES 1–6,

Defendants. ____________________________________/

Case No. 1:26-cv-02331

[PROPOSED] ORDER

This matter is before the Court on Plaintiff’s Rule 60(a) Motion to Clarify or Correct ECF No. 108 (the “Motion”). Upon consideration of the Motion and the Memorandum in Support, it is hereby

ORDERED that the Motion is GRANTED IN PART, to the extent of the clarification stated in this Order, and is otherwise DENIED; and it is

FURTHER ORDERED that the Court clarifies that the sentence at ECF No. 108 at 2 reading “Here, the record reflects that the District Judge has chosen to refrain from beginning any discovery until resolution of the pending motions to dismiss” describes the following judicial action, as stated in the Court’s accompanying explanation or as set forth here: ________________________________________________________________; and it is

FURTHER ORDERED that the Court clarifies that, as understood by the Court when ECF No. 108 issued, the action so identified related to the following steps in the following manner:

(a)	entry of a scheduling order under Rule 16(b) and the alternative initial pretrial conference requested in ECF No. 103: ________________________________________;

(b)	the parties’ conference under Rule 26(f) and the discovery-plan report requested in ECF No. 105: ________________________________________;

(c)	substantive discovery: ________________________________________; and it is

FURTHER ORDERED that, as to the Rule 26(f) planning steps requested in ECF No. 105, ECF No. 108 was intended to have the following effect: ______________________; and it is

FURTHER ORDERED that the following textual correction, if any, is made to the identified sentence at ECF No. 108 at 2: ______________________. If no replacement text is stated, the existing text remains unchanged; and it is

FURTHER ORDERED that this Order does not grant ECF No. 103 or ECF No. 105, does not enter a scheduling order, does not authorize or impose any discovery, disclosure, or reporting obligation, and does not resolve any separately filed application for reconsideration or review. The denial without prejudice of ECF Nos. 103 and 105 in ECF No. 108 is unchanged by this Order.

The Clerk is directed to forward a copy of this Order to all counsel of record and to provide a copy to pro se Plaintiff at his last known address.

Alexandria, Virginia

__________, 2026

______________________________

William E. Fitzpatrick

United States Magistrate Judge
